description: Single canonical acceptance schema for FlyBrain releases. The runner (scripts/run_acceptance_matrix.py) MUST evaluate exactly these categories; README/ARCHITECTURE/RESEARCH_STATUS/release notes MUST derive their totals from diagnostics/acceptance_matrix.json generated from this schema. Never hard-code stale totals into documents.

failure_policy.FAIL: a required check failed -> release blocked
failure_policy.SKIP_ENVIRONMENT: allowed ONLY when the environment genuinely lacks the capability (no GPU, no GGUF weights, no portable bundle); reason must name the missing capability
failure_policy.ERROR: ambiguous or unverifiable result -> treated as FAIL for release gating

workstation.description: Windows 11 + AMD Vulkan GPU + local GGUF weights present
workstation.expected: 56 PASS / 1 SKIP (portable_package) / 0 FAIL, or 57 PASS with FLYBRAIN_PORTABLE_DIR built

vulkan.description: Any host with a Vulkan compute device
vulkan.expected: vulkan_discovery_and_selection, persistent_resource_lifecycle, cpu_vulkan_numerical_parity MUST PASS (never SKIP)

cpu-only.expected: vulkan_discovery_and_selection, persistent_resource_lifecycle, cpu_vulkan_numerical_parity SKIP_ENVIRONMENT with reason; all other required categories PASS

ci.description: GitHub Actions ubuntu/windows runners (no GPU, no GGUF)
ci.expected: vulkan_* (3) + llm_model_discovery_and_inference SKIP_ENVIRONMENT; remainder PASS; 0 FAIL

huggingface.expected: same SKIPs as cpu-only plus llm_model_discovery_and_inference SKIP_ENVIRONMENT; health/version/doctor endpoints PASS; UI serves live backend state

release.description: Gate for tagging a stable release
release.expected: 0 FAIL across all evaluated categories; every SKIP_ENVIRONMENT justified by missing capability; docs verification PASS; provenance verification PASS; replay PASS; checkpoint continuation PASS; UI real-endpoint PASS; Hugging Face verification PASS or documented external blocker
